text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, hey, Doto-chan!
Is it really okay for me to order the extra-large shrimp fried rice!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. Since we have these meal vouchers, please feel free to order whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Man oh man, that really is lucky and happy, Doto-san! Finding last year's New Year's money by pure coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I wonder if forgetting you even had it can really be called lucky... Besides, are you sure about this? Spending it all on us.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ha-ha-ha! What a truly marvelous banquet! Let us toast to Doto's generosity!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: N-No, it's totally fine! I'm just going to the restroom, so please go ahead and order without holding back.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (*Sigh*... I'm so glad. Everyone seems to be really enjoying themselves...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(And this was all thanks to this meal voucher...
Wait, huh? ...Huuuh!?)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Huh... Whaaat!? Th-This...
expired last month!?!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-Wh-Wh-What am I gonna dooo!?
I barely have any cash on me either...!)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So yummy~! The shrimp is so plump and juicy~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Just look at the red-and-white harmony of this naruto,
and the way it spirals! This is guaranteed to boost our fortune~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Th-They're having such a wonderful time,
I can't possibly bring this up now...!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(If it's come to this, if it's come to this...
Uuu... there's only one thing left to do...!!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ Thank you for the wonderful meal~!
Full bellies bring boundless blessings!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, I haven't seen our gracious host
for a while now... Where could she
have disappeared to?

E-Excuse me, esteemed guests... Would you
care for some sweet dim sum for dessert~?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, me, me, pick me!! Then um,
five sesame balls and five almond jellies, please!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-Order placed~! Sesame balls,
almond jelly, for table threeee...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, what are you doing!?
Doto!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So, um... I realized the voucher was expired and
that I didn't have enough cash, and my head started spinning—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I figured the classic solution at times like this
is to pay off the bill by washing dishes or helping out...
so I decided to put myself to work as a waitress.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... We could have just
split the bill between all of us.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on a moment. It seems the magic on
this ticket hasn't run out just yet, you know?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Eh? Wh-What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Mumu! It clearly says it expires next year!
Which means far from expiring last month,
it's good for an entire year!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-So I was just panicking over a complete misunderstanding...!
Th-This is so embarrassingggg~~!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... you run off on your own way too easily.
And here we were, discussing how to return the favor.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh...? R-Return the favor...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yep! We were whispering about it while you were gone!
Next time, all of us are gonna treat YOU to a feast!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Accompanied by my very own dinner show, of course!
Hahaha! A magnificent idea, wouldn't you say!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I will find the ultimate venue, carefully aligning auspicious days and feng shui!
How does that sound, Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: —Y-Yes, please! I'd love that, everyoneee!
